templates.note: POST workflowTemplate=image_upscale；lanczos 缩放 + 更高 megapixels/steps，真上采样后再走 Flux2。
POST workflowTemplate=background_repaint；提高 CFG + 中等 steps，配合背景向提示词。
workflowTemplate=jewelry_product_cutout；高 CFG + 10 步，利于干净边缘与白底。

hint.en: Metal highlights & gemstone fire; keep shape.
hint.zh: 强化金属高光与火彩，不改变轮廓。

hint.en: Clean edges; pure or soft white backdrop.
hint.zh: 边缘干净，纯白或柔和白底。

prompt.en: Place on deep navy velvet with soft studio light, subtle gradient, premium catalog look.
prompt.zh: 深蓝丝绒衬底，柔和棚拍光，轻微渐变，高级目录风。

prompt.en: Elegant white marble surface with thin gold trim reflections, soft daylight window.
prompt.zh: 白色大理石台面与细金边反射感，柔和日光窗光。

prompt.en: Warm rose-gold bokeh background, shallow depth of field, jewelry hero framing.
prompt.zh: 暖玫瑰金散景背景，浅景深，珠宝主图构图。

prompt.en: Minimal gray seamless cyclorama, soft top light, e-commerce 360-style pad.
prompt.zh: 极简灰色无缝弧面，顶柔光，电商转盘台风格。

prompt.en: Dark walnut display stand, soft side light, cultural luxury still life.
prompt.zh: 深色胡桃木座，侧柔光，文玩静物质感。

prompt.en: Soft champagne satin drape, gentle folds, warm key light, high-end boutique still life.
prompt.zh: 香槟色缎面衬布，柔和褶皱纹理，暖主光，精品店静物感。

prompt.en: Sleek black acrylic riser, crisp reflections, controlled studio rim light, modern catalog.
prompt.zh: 黑色亚克力几何展台，克制反光与轮廓光，现代目录棚拍。

prompt.en: Frosted glass surface with soft diffusion, cool-neutral fill, minimal luxury tabletop.
prompt.zh: 磨砂玻璃台面，柔和漫反射，冷中性补光，极简轻奢台面。

prompt.en: Warm late-afternoon sunlight, long soft shadows, editorial jewelry hero without harsh hotspots.
prompt.zh: 暖色夕阳光感，长而柔和的阴影，杂志主图光比，避免过曝高光斑。

prompt.en: Seamless cool teal-to-graphite gradient cyclorama, softbox key, subtle edge light on metal.
prompt.zh: 青绿至石墨灰无缝渐变背景，柔光箱主光，金属边缘略提亮。

promptHint.en: Top-down or 3/4 hero angle; band and stone centered; even reflections.
promptHint.zh: 俯视或四分之三主图角；戒圈与主石居中，反射均匀。

promptHint.en: Gentle S-curve lay flat; clasp hidden; chain links readable.
promptHint.zh: 柔和 S 形平铺；链节清晰，扣件尽量不抢眼。

promptHint.en: Symmetric pair layout or single stud macro; ear post not distorted.
promptHint.zh: 对称耳对或单颗耳钉微距；针脚不畸变。

promptHint.en: Soft oval loop; inner shine visible; clasp area clean.
promptHint.zh: 柔和椭圆环状；内壁高光可见，扣合区干净。

promptHint.en: Subsurface glow, gentle translucency, no oversharpened veins.
promptHint.zh: 体现温润通透感，纹理不过锐。

promptHint.en: Dial legible; crystal reflections controlled; crown detail preserved.
promptHint.zh: 表盘可读，表镜反光克制，表冠细节保留。

promptHint.en: Bail and chain entry visible; pendant faces camera; avoid twisted links.
promptHint.zh: 扣头与链节入口清晰，坠体正面朝向镜头，链节尽量不绞在一起。

promptHint.en: Pin mechanism discreet; frontal or slight 3/4; stones and enamel read clearly.
promptHint.zh: 针背结构尽量不抢眼，正面或略四分之三角，宝石与珐琅层次可读。

promptHint.en: Luster gradient along each pearl; knot spacing even; no plastic chalky look.
promptHint.zh: 每颗珍珠体现光泽渐变，打结间距均匀，避免塑料发闷感。

promptHint.en: Pair aligned symmetrically; face detail sharp; backs minimal in frame.
promptHint.zh: 成对对称摆放，正面细节清晰，背面尽量少入画。

promptHint.en: Premium product photo; neutral composition bias.

prompt.en: Professional portrait retouch: even skin tone, natural catchlights, subtle sharpening, keep identity and pose unchanged.
prompt.zh: 人像精修：均匀肤色、自然眼神光、轻微锐化，保持五官与姿态不变。

prompt.en: Apply a subtle vintage film look: warm faded shadows, fine grain, slightly lowered contrast, keep composition unchanged.
prompt.zh: 复古胶片感：暖调褪色阴影、细腻颗粒、略降对比度，保持构图不变。

prompt.en: Clean ID-photo style: neutral background if possible, even lighting on face, natural color, no heavy makeup, keep subject unchanged.
prompt.zh: 证件照风格：背景尽量简洁中性、面部光线均匀、色彩自然、淡妆感，主体不变。

prompt.en: Enhance clarity and micro-detail: sharper edges, reduce noise, preserve original composition and content, avoid hallucinated new objects.
prompt.zh: 提升清晰度与细节：边缘更锐利、降噪，保持原构图与内容，不要凭空增加物体。

prompt.en: Replace or repaint ONLY the background; keep the foreground subject pixel-accurate with clean edges; seamless blend.
prompt.zh: 仅替换或重绘背景，前景主体边缘干净、与背景自然融合，不改变主体形状。

prompt.en: Polish precious metal reflections and gemstone fire; micro-contrast on facets; no geometry change.
prompt.zh: 强化贵金属反光与宝石火彩，刻面微对比，不改变几何外形。

prompt.en: Isolate product on pure white #FFFFFF seamless background; crisp edge; soft contact shadow only.
prompt.zh: 纯白无缝背景商品隔离；边缘利落，仅保留极轻接触阴影。

prompt.en: Enhance sparkle without blown highlights; natural CA control; keep stone color accurate.
prompt.zh: 增强闪光但不过曝；色散自然；宝石颜色准确。

prompt.en: For vintage pieces: respect patina; clean dust only; do not fake new plating.
prompt.zh: 古着感：保留自然包浆，仅去浮尘，不伪造新镀层。
